notes.title: Battlemon's New Update
notes.content:
Battlemon has not been receiving any updates recently, due to the game currently being recoded again, from the ground up, only reusing audio and some sprites. The recode has been in development for around a month, as of writing this.

[h1]Why?[/h1]

This is because of how badly the game was put together, and the original engine for Battlemon, not easily supporting multiple characters, and not being easy to edit due to how it was coded, which caused a lot of lag while playing the game, and editing it.

The current version of Battlemon will not be receiving any further updates, besides maybe some bug fixes and other small things, but I doubt it.

[h1]What will the recode bring?[/h1]

As the game is being recoded, every character will have a completely different moveset, stats, animations, etc. The combat will be much more skill based, and be more fast-paced than the previous version. Leaks of the progress being made will be posted here if major, or on the discord server: https://discord.gg/5njuqZeRaw


You can expect:
[b]- Reimagined movesets for all characters
- Way better balancing
- Better designed stages
- Better visuals and music
- Local Multiplayer (Same device, not online)
- Better Optimisation
- Controller Support
- Story Mode, which would be similar to an RPG, such as Paper Mario
- More characters brought over from the first version of Battlemon, with a new coat of paint
- More singleplayer content
- Probably more stuff
- Roll dodges, spot dodges, and air dodges[/b]
[h3][b][u]PROBABLY[/u][/b][/h3] a release of Battlemon on other stores, such as on Xbox. I really really REALLY doubt that one though

By Battlemon's release, all, or most, at least, of these features should be implemented into the game. Currently, the only finished character is Dunse. Major news, such as this will be posted onto Steam, smaller things will be on discord.


[h1]When will the recode release?[/h1]

The recode will be releasing sometime this year, expect at least 4 characters on release, and 5 stages, reimagined from the previous version of Battlemon. Additionally, Battlemon will be receiving updates monthly, after release. showed off some stuff about the game in like 21 fps here: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mkxQnR-ueOM


^ Music used in the game right now is NOT mine, it is from MT's game, back and forth:  https://gamejolt.com/games/backnforth/856529

ok bye
- Dreemore

notes.title: Battlemon Pre-Alpha V0.01 is released!
notes.content:
Battlemon has been update to V0.01, and is now in Pre-Alpha! (Not sure what it was classified as before, it certainly [b]existed[/b], though). [b]Note, there are 1 or 2 tracks in the game that are NOT MINE![/b]
The idea for Shift is inspired by Sans from Undertale, which is why they can dodge attacks, and have very low HP.

New Major Changes:

- New Character, Shift the Human, who works together with a Phantasm in battle
- More Progress on Abble's moveset (new mode, new moves for him, etc)

Minor Changes/Patch notes:

- Game Optimisation and size reduction by removing unused sounds
- Dunse normal side attack increased hitbox
- Dunse normal side attack both hits connect properly
- Working on Entrances and Death scenes for characters (So far only Shift has this)
- Corrodon water up attack hitbox increase
- Abble normal up attack is now holdable
- Abble normal up attack changed (Number of Oranges changed from 3 to 6 --> always 5)

- Changed the Dummy (player 2)'s ULT, (Spawns 200 bullets --> spawns 400 bullets, + some now aim)
- Added an extra ULT to the Dummy, for testing purposes (maybe)
- Blocking moves isn't as reliable, as some moves may break blocks
- Abble ULT now breaks block
- Abble normal up attack no longer shakes the camera
- New status effect, Poisoning, chance to be inflicted by Shift's spike attacks
- Corrodon water up attack knockback change (55 knockback force --> 22 knockback force)
- Abble no longer has the "pellet" attack that Packige has
- Corrodon normal down attack now has just barely enough stun to lead into normal neutral attack
- Corrodon normal up attack tracking and distance improved
- Abble normal neutral attack reduced endlag (1.5s --> 0.2)
